purpose: Independent cross-A disassembly check that the compiled per-step kernel is instruction-count invariant under the adder-table size A, supporting the retune from A=2^24 to A=2^28 of the accepted crown (961165d1).
source: measurement/step.c with measurement/{p256_field.h,p256_sub.h,p256_fused.h,bloop_branchy.h,floop.h} (byte-identical to the accepted crown blinded-flag-unroll8 kernel)

batch_step.note: identical; the organizer reference image reported 11602 for this kernel family, the difference is the compiler build, not A

common_path_differences: only extr/ubfiz/and immediates of the DP test and adder index, plus dead alignment nops and branch-target renumbering; no change to the executed common-path instruction count
conclusion: The per-processed-step charge (PLAIN_FIXED, C_COMMON) measured for the crown at 2^20 adders is carried to A=2^28 unchanged; only rare-path OVERHEAD absorbs the few extra instructions.
